notes.title: 3D Upgrade – Blood FX Reveal
notes.notes:
[p]I’ve added a completely new 3D blood effect system to the game.
It was quite a challenge to implement, but the result takes the battles to a whole new level of atmosphere.[/p][p]Next up are ranged weapons, which will be added to the game soon.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone following and supporting the development! If you want to stay up to date, make sure to follow the game here on Steam and check back regularly.[/p][p]Check it out on YouTube:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718600/Tainted_by_the_Stars_The_Dead_Among_Us/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: From 2D to 3D – New Player Animations and Weapon Preview
notes.notes: [p]The work on the new player animations is complete: the transition from 2D to 3D is done, making the gameplay more dynamic.[/p][p]Next, the focus shifts to weapons. First screenshots already show new models – with more weapons currently in development.[/p][p]In addition, the visible attachments will later be unlockable and purchasable, allowing you to customize your playstyle even further.[/p][p]Stay tuned – more updates are coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Short gameplay animation video: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/JaQ5pq8PgJc"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Here the weapon preview:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647997/26766dff91fb6962a73bdb1735e441cae5493fc9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: From 2D to 3D Top-Down
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647997/7d09392ef374b602cc054c01698ac0cf01474c4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Today I reached an important milestone: switching from a pure 2D setup to a real [b]3D top-down perspective[/b].[/p][list][*][p]My camera is now [b]perspective-based[/b], looking down at the scene from an angle.[/p][/*][*][p]My character no longer moves on a flat XY plane, but across the [b]XZ plane[/b] – just like in proper 3D games.[/p][/*][*][p]This instantly gives me [b]real depth, shadows and lighting[/b], which changes the look and feel a lot.[/p][/*][/list][p]This was only the first step. Over the next days I want to implement player rotation towards the cursor, adjust aiming and shooting for 3D, and rebuild the enemy AI. Step by step my project will grow into a full 3D top-down shooter.[/p]

notes.title: Big Step Before Alpha – From 2D to 3D Lighting
notes.notes:
[p][b]Big Step Before Alpha – From 2D to 3D Lighting[/b][/p][p]My game was already close to hitting Alpha – in 2D. But right before that milestone, I decided to take a bold step: moving the entire lighting and shadow system into 3D.[/p][p]In 2D, I used the [i]Smart Lighting 2D[/i] asset. It blends multiple light layers in the shader to create atmospheric shadows and light cones. Works great – but it’s still flat.[/p][p]In the new 3D approach, lighting happens “for real” in space:[/p][list][*][p]Every lamp, torch, or flashlight actually shines into the game world.[/p][/*][*][p]Light can bounce off walls, and shadows are dynamically cast by objects.[/p][/*][*][p]When I move or open a door, the lighting changes instantly – just like in real life.[/p][/*][/list][p]This prototype exists for one reason:
To see if I can capture the same dense atmosphere as in 2D – but with more realism, more depth, and far greater gameplay possibilities.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718600/Tainted_by_the_Stars_The_Dead_Among_Us/" style="button"]Add the game to your wishlist now to keep up to date![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Scene View[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647997/f211ac886b4f02dd3c947ea57feea2c518d82a47.png"][/img][/p][p]Game View. This is what I think a good perspective.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45647997/8e4fe4b71961164e484edc200bfc19c4dd4f81fe.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Prototyping to work in 3D
notes.notes: [p]I'm currently working on a prototype to transform the game completely to 3D.[/p][p][/p][p]The main issue that the prototype must resolve is to display the field of view in 3D instead of 2D.[/p][p][/p][p]If that works, the possibilities will be endless![/p][p][/p][p]I update you soon about my results! :)[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Christian[/p]
